report_name: Aeternum Botnet Uses Polygon Blockchain for Resilient C2

attack_patterns.name: Dynamic Resolution
attack_patterns.description: The Aeternum botnet uses the public Polygon blockchain as a decentralized and dynamic C2 resolution mechanism, querying smart contracts via public RPC endpoints to fetch commands.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The Aeternum loader downloads secondary payloads, such as a malicious DotNetZip.dll and the XMRig cryptominer, from external sources like GitHub.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: The Aeternum loader is packed with UPX and uses a custom XOR-based encryption scheme to hide critical strings, such as JSON-RPC request templates.

attack_patterns.name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
attack_patterns.description: The Aeternum loader includes checks to detect if it is running within a virtual machine or an analysis environment to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Windows Command Shell
attack_patterns.description: The Windows Command Shell is used by the Aeternum loader to execute downloaded secondary payloads.

malware.name: Aeternum
malware.description: A C++ botnet loader that uses the Polygon blockchain for a decentralized C2 infrastructure. It features anti-evasion techniques and is used to deliver secondary payloads like cryptominers.

malware.name: XMRig
malware.description: A cryptominer observed as a secondary payload delivered by the Aeternum botnet loader.

malware.name: DotNetZip.dll
malware.description: A malicious DLL downloaded by the Aeternum loader from a GitHub repository as a secondary payload.

tools.name: PuTTY
tools.description: A legitimate installer for PuTTY was observed being downloaded by the Aeternum loader, likely for testing purposes.

infrastructure.name: Aeternum Blockchain C2
infrastructure.description: A decentralized command-and-control infrastructure leveraging smart contracts on the public Polygon blockchain to issue commands to infected bots.

infrastructure.name: Polygon Public RPC Endpoints
infrastructure.description: Publicly accessible gateways to the Polygon network, such as polygon-rpc.com, which are queried by Aeternum bots to retrieve C2 commands from smart contracts.

indicators.name: Aeternum Loader Hash Detection
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Aeternum Botnet Loader File Hash
id: 2b1a8f3c-5d7e-4b9a-8c6d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects the presence of the Aeternum botnet loader binary by its SHA256 hash.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/aeternum-blockchain-c2-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1105
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Hashes|contains: 'SHA256=5bfb25b8255b61e5ffdf6804451534bcfa9f1dfd225e6c8cdcefb5f50d846898'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the Aeternum loader file `Build.exe` based on its SHA256 hash.

indicators.name: Aeternum C2 RPC Endpoint Detection
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Aeternum Botnet C2 Communication via Polygon RPC
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4b-4c3d-2b1a-0f9e8d7c6b5a
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to a public Polygon RPC endpoint known to be used by the Aeternum botnet for C2.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/aeternum-blockchain-c2-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1568
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName: 'polygon-rpc.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network connections to the public Polygon RPC endpoint `polygon-rpc.com` used by Aeternum for C2 communications.

indicators.name: Aeternum Blockchain C2 RPC Call Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Aeternum Botnet Blockchain C2 Call
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects HTTP POST requests to Polygon RPC endpoints containing the specific JSON-RPC method and function selector used by the Aeternum botnet to retrieve C2 commands.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/aeternum-blockchain-c2-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1568
  - attack.command_and_control
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    c-uri|contains: 'polygon-rpc.com'
    cs-bytes|contains|all:
      - '"method":"eth_call"'
      - '"data":"0xb68d1809'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific JSON-RPC `eth_call` method and `getDomain()` function selector (`0xb68d1809`) used by Aeternum to query its C2 smart contract.

relationships.source_name: Aeternum Blockchain C2 RPC Call Detection
